recommendation: Keep this commit. It fixes the remaining current build-scoped FHIR ModelInfo inconsistency for FHIR-25287 while preserving the later FHIR-32447 outcome backbone model; future terminology or binding changes should be handled under their specific later Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-25287 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and asked to remove AuditEvent.outcomeDesc while changing AuditEvent.outcome to a 0..1 CodeableConcept that could carry text and alternate codings such as HTTP response classes.
initial_application: Git history shows initial application in d97f7c47d, which changed AuditEvent examples from separate outcome/outcomeDesc elements to CodeableConcept outcome, and early R4B StructureDefinition source carried AuditEvent.outcome as CodeableConcept with no outcomeDesc. Security WG minutes later listed FHIR-25287 as applied to FHIR core.
additional_context: FHIR-32447 later superseded the CodeableConcept shape with the current outcome backbone containing required outcome.code and repeatable outcome.detail CodeableConcept entries; the combined branch already contains the FHIR-32447 reconciliation commit. Current AuditEvent source is active and already has no outcomeDesc, while Library is also active and exposes the FHIR ModelInfo content as a CQL tooling example. The separate QUICK model-definition example remains legacy QUICK content and was intentionally left unchanged.
reconciliation: Updated source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml to add AuditEvent.Outcome, point AuditEvent.outcome to FHIR.AuditEvent.Outcome, and remove AuditEvent.outcomeDesc; refreshed source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml so its embedded data matches the readable ModelInfo file.
source_changes: source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml: added FHIR.AuditEvent.Outcome backbone metadata with code and repeatable detail, changed AuditEvent.outcome to that backbone, and removed stale AuditEvent.outcomeDesc.
source/library/library-fhir-model-definition.xml: refreshed the embedded base64 ModelInfo payload to match the updated readable content file.

related_jiras.note: Later Published Security decision replaced the FHIR-25287 CodeableConcept outcome with the current outcome backbone/code/detail model and is already represented on the combined branch.

Later outcome terminology decision moved AuditEvent outcome semantics away from DICOM numeric codes toward issue-severity plus success; it informs the current outcome.code context but was not part of this seed fix.
